collection: Anomalous Knowledge Archive: verified live sample
notice: Read-only bibliographic sample: sources are linked, not copied. Historical claims remain unverified and disputed. Full 66-record research package is separate.

items.title: Duke Parapsychology Laboratory records
items.editorial_note: Original laboratory research files and correspondence; reproductions require permission.

items.title: Eileen J. Garrett Research Library at UMBC
items.editorial_note: More than 12,000 volumes and 100 periodicals; reading-room access, not a free redistribution licence.

items.title: Harold Saxton Burr Papers MS 1283
items.editorial_note: Original electrodynamic research notebooks on trees, 1940–1959; Yale states that copyright status is unknown.

items.title: Bio-Electric Correlates of Human Ovulation
items.editorial_note: Recorded measurable tissue potentials; not a validated diagnostic test or proof of supernatural auras.

items.title: Evidence for an Electro-Dynamic Field in Living Organisms
items.editorial_note: Proposes a field-based interpretation of living-system electrical gradients; the interpretation remains separate from observations.

items.title: Field Properties of the Developing Frog’s Egg
items.editorial_note: Original published embryological investigation.

items.title: Mysterious Phenomena of the Human Psyche (Russian edition)
items.editorial_note: Russian State Library catalogues an original-language edition; viewer access is not a copying licence.

items.title: Experiments in Mental Suggestion (English translation)
items.editorial_note: English translation held by Wellcome; not freely redistributable.

items.title: Perceptual Augmentation Techniques, Part Two
items.editorial_note: Historical intelligence-linked research discussing Vasiliev and Kogan. Declassification is not validation of their claims.

items.title: An Experimental Approach to Dreams and Telepathy
items.editorial_note: Original laboratory methodology and preliminary findings.

items.title: Telepathic Perception in the Dream State
items.editorial_note: Reported positive results from EEG-monitored dream comparison; not independently established telepathy.

items.title: Telepathy and Dreams: A Controlled Experiment
items.editorial_note: Journal-indexed controlled experiment and method.

items.title: Maimonides Dream Telepathy: Independent Replications
items.editorial_note: Summary includes disputed replication evidence and methodological criticisms.

items.title: PEAR random-event-generator consortium replication
items.editorial_note: A multi-laboratory attempt did not reproduce the primary effect at conventional significance.

items.title: Intentional Observer Effects on Quantum Randomness
items.editorial_note: Reports evidence against the micro-psychokinesis hypothesis.

items.title: The Human Atmosphere
items.editorial_note: Illustrated historical aura experiments and diagrams; medical/psychic claims unverified.

items.title: Thought-Forms
items.editorial_note: Illustrated symbolic classification of claimed thought colours and forms.

items.title: Ganzfeld Research Database
items.editorial_note: Downloadable study metadata; effect interpretation disputed, redistribution terms need review.

items.title: CIA STARGATE collection
items.editorial_note: Declassified records document official investigation, not demonstration of psychic functioning.

items.title: Image Modulation in Corona Discharge Photography
items.editorial_note: Explains optical variations through discharge, moisture and other physical conditions.
